sections.html: About this gallery. Every photo here is a final, retouched selection in full resolution — download and use them across your site, decks, and social channels; a photo credit is appreciated, never required. Need a specific crop, a print-ready file, or the raw set for your comms team? Just ask — revisions are included, and the usage FAQ covers licensing in plain language.
